Messages.Author: Pat
Messages.Body:

news:1139701260.8...@g47g2000cwa.googlegroups.com...


You'd probably have to invent time travel and go back and ask one of the
Wiecks to get a direct answer to that question, but don't forget that Theo
Bell, Victoria Ash, Aisling Sturbridge, Sascha Vykos, etc. all play major
roles in the Clan Novel series.

Plus Aisling is in the (weak) Tremere trilogy, Theo's in the (quite good)
Brujah trilogy, a number of Giovanni appear in the Horizon War and Red Death
trilogies, and lots of our pals (Lucita, Fatima, Fidus, Karsh, etc.) appear
in the Dark Ages clan novels.

The later oWoD fiction was MUCH better than the early stuff, IMO, so if you
liked any of the early stuff, you should definitely check out some of the
later fiction.

- Pat
